title: SessionSelection
description: The resolved output of `mise run kb-session-select`: which Claude Code session transcripts a run should cover, and how each one's clock was established. Consumed by the kb-session-review skill and passed into the session-review workflow, which re-refuses on shape — so this is a cross-surface contract rather than a repo-internal record, which is why it is generated rather than hand-written.

selector.description: The selector as invoked, echoed verbatim.

window.description: Echoed even for a non-time selector, with null bounds.

resolved_by.description: Which route produced this set; --current has two that can disagree.

caveat.description: The resolution is sound but contested; present means read it.

sessions.description: Never empty; an empty resolution is a refusal, not an empty list.

started_at.description: When the session STARTED, ISO 8601 UTC. Birthtime, not mtime.

last_written.description: mtime, ISO 8601 UTC; beside started_at so a resume stays visible.

time_source.description: Which clock set started_at: birthtime, the file's record, or mtime.
